The link is `<PORTAL_BASE_URL>/set-password?token=<token>`, built from a new config key PORTAL_BASE_URL, the counterpart of the console base URL. resolutions.decision: Automatic-gateway top-ups. The confirmation webhook creates or updates the payment as status 'pending' with captured_at = the confirmation time and auto_credit_at = captured_at + max(setting payments.auto_credit_delay_minutes (10), hold_hours h). While waiting, note = 'Credited automatically after the gateway check at <time>'. The auto-credit job locks the row (SELECT … FOR UPDATE), re-checks the gateway API and risk, then posts the deposit (status approved, reviewed_by NULL, reviewed_at = now). On the wire that shows as reviewedBy {id: null, name: 'System'}. If the gateway no longer says confirmed, or risk flags the payment, the job sets review_required = true, note = the reason, and leaves it pending for staff. approve and reject are allowed only when the gateway is_manual or review_required = true. Otherwise they answer 409 PAYMENT_AUTO_CREDIT_PENDING (new code, detail 'PAY-<id> is credited automatically after the gateway check.'). The job and approve both lock the payment row, re-check status = 'pending', and post with the same ledger idempotency key 'deposit:payment:<id>'. A loser of the race gets 409 PAYMENT_ALREADY_REVIEWED, and its replay posts nothing.
resolutions.basis: User rule 6 (PROGRESS, settings Q9): automatic gateways credit by themselves after the delay, flagged payments go to staff review, and manual gateways keep staff review. The console's PaymentReviewer allows id null with a name. ANSWERS finance Q5 (pending-only guard plus ledger idempotency). The column, error code and lock order are technical choices.

resolutions.decision: User decision applied. In one transaction: if the service has any orders, service_supplier_links or service_listings, or any other RESTRICT reference (inventory_codes, checkout_sessions, help_articles, imei_checks), ARCHIVE it: archived_at = now(), status = 'disabled', its scope='service' pricing_rules set is_active = false; fields/options/group prices/client prices/links/codes are kept (history; open orders continue and can still dispatch). Otherwise HARD DELETE: delete scope='service' pricing_rules with target_id = id, then the service (fields, options, group prices, client prices, supplier links cascade). Both answer 204 (no 409 SERVICE_IN_USE any more), audit-logged with action archived service or deleted service (the demo's verb phrases, ANSWERS audit Q3). An archived service is gone for every reader: GET /admin/services list and :id (404 NOT_FOUND), PATCH/PUT parts (404), GET /admin/client-prices, merchant catalogs (Dhru *servicelist, /v1/services, /client/services, price export), storefront listings (public and admin lists), bulk price, resolve (404); placement treats it as an unknown service; pricing rule rows still resolve its target {id,name}. resolutions.decision: One resolver (catalog public PriceResolver, used by resolve, orders, price lists, client/group price checks): (1) step 'client' (service_client_prices) wins; (2) step 'group' (service_group_prices for the group) wins if no client price; (3) step 'base' = services.base_price, apply unless fixed; (4) step id 'category' (kept for the console's fraction display), label 'Service rule' | 'Category rule' | 'Global rule' by the winning rule's scope: pick ONE rule with is_active, (starts_at null or <= now), (ends_at null or > now), group_id null or = the merchant's group, target matching (service: target_id = service id; category: target_id = category id; global); order by scope (service, category, global), then priority asc, then group-specific before group-null, then id asc. If not fixed: p = p x (1 + s x percent/100) + s x fixed, s = +1 for margin, -1 for discount/promo; value = signed fraction (after/before - 1, 4 dp), note names the rule and any fixed amount; (5) step 'discount' = client_groups.discount_percent/100, apply if not fixed; then round half-up to 2 dp; (6) step id 'rounding', label 'Rounding', emitted only when not fixed and the winning rule's rounding <> 'none': nearest_0.05 / nearest_0.10 = half-up to that step, ends_99 = floor(p) + 0.99; value and after = the rounded price; rawPrice = price after step 6; (7) floor clamp: floor = effective_cost + minProfit; price = max(rawPrice, floor), clamped. minProfit = services.min_profit if not null, else min_profit of the first rule in the step-4 order (same filters) with min_profit > 0, else max(round(6% x effective_cost, 2), 0.02). Without a merchant (admin rows, belowFloor, PATCH basePrice, bulk) only group_id-null rules match. otherGroups = every b2b group, no client override. Fixed (client/group) prices skip steps 4-6, as in the demo.
resolutions.basis: User rule 8 / OPEN-QUESTIONS 8 / ANSWERS services Q6 combined: the demo's order (Q6, user-decided) with rounding after the group discount (OQ8, user-accepted) and 'most specific scope wins, lowest priority within a scope' (Q6). resolutions.decision: dispatch_state transition table (decision 025 addendum): placement → held (B2C risk hold) | done (inventory code delivered at once) | manual (fulfillment manual or no active supplier link) | pending (else; dispatch job enqueued). Dispatch job: REFERENCEID → sent (status processing, sent_at); explicit refusal, timeout, or no eligible link (disabled/paused/costlier than the charged price, B117(6)) → needs_attention (status unchanged, review event with reason). Poll/fetch: STATUS 4 → done + completed; STATUS 3 → done + rejected; still running from needs_attention → sent. accept: manual → operator (status processing, queue null). reply: any open, not held → done + completed. reject: any open, not held → done + rejected. refund (B2B completed): stays done, status rejected. reopen: completed → operator (status processing, queue null). verification accept: stays done (verification_status accepted); verification refund: done + rejected (refunded). Risk approve: held → pending (or manual per the placement rule); risk refund: held → done + rejected. Merchant cancel: pending|manual|held → done + rejected. Staff dispatch: from needs_attention|manual|operator → pending + job; pending → 204 no-op (already queued); held → 409 ORDER_HELD; sent → 409 ALREADY_SENT ('The supplier already has this order: fetch it, or change supplier with a reset reference first'). change-supplier: keeps dispatch_state, except sent + resetReference → needs_attention (reason 'Supplier changed: dispatch needed'); with dispatch: true → pending + job. Queue derivation unchanged: operator, sent, done → null. Each action gets a test of its resulting queue.

resolutions.decision: Add an explicit outcome to every supplier call log: ok | error | timeout, written by the supplier client (feature 6). timeout = the outbound call hit timeoutMs or the network timed out (no HTTP answer); error = any other failure (network error, HTTP >= 400, unparsable answer, Dhru ERROR result even on HTTP 200); ok otherwise. Over the last 15 min per supplier: errorRate = error/total x 100, timeoutRate = timeout/total x 100 (separate, a timeout is not also an error); no calls -> {value null, state unknown}. lastSuccessAt = max(created_at where outcome = 'ok', latest ok service check). lastSyncAt = GREATEST(suppliers.balance_checked_at, suppliers.prices_synced_at) (null when both null); the price sync sets prices_synced_at at the end of a successful run.
resolutions.basis: ANSWERS system-health Q24 (Postgres-sourced rates over 15 min); queues.md supplier-sync (price sync + balance check); predicates on free error text are fragile, so a column is the technical choice.
resolutions.schemaChange: ALTER TABLE supplier_api_logs ADD COLUMN outcome text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ok', ADD CONSTRAINT supplier_api_logs_outcome_check CHECK (outcome IN ('ok','error','timeout')); backfill UPDATE supplier_api_logs SET outcome = CASE WHEN http_status IS NULL AND error ILIKE '%timeout%' THEN 'timeout' WHEN error IS NOT NULL OR http_status >= 400 THEN 'error' ELSE 'ok' END. ALTER TABLE suppliers ADD COLUMN prices_synced_at timestamptz NULL. Existing index supplier_api_logs_supplier_created_idx covers the 15-min window.
resolutions.docFixes: endpoints/health.md GET /admin/system/suppliers: write the outcome predicates, rate formulas, lastSuccessAt and lastSyncAt formulas. docs/queues.md supplier-sync: the price sync sets suppliers.prices_synced_at.

Card fingerprint = the gateway's card fingerprint (e.g. Stripe payment_method.card.fingerprint), written by the B2C payment webhook into a new payments column.
